label: Acts reports Peter's Pentecost speech: Jesus was a man attested to the hearers by God through the…
paraphrase: Acts reports Peter's Pentecost speech: Jesus was a man attested (apodedeigmenon) to the hearers by God through the mighty works, wonders and signs God did through him; God raised him, of which the apostles are witnesses; exalted to God's right hand he poured out the promised Spirit; therefore all Israel is to know assuredly (asphalōs) that God has made him both Lord and Christ. Textual report only: neither the historicity of the speech nor the occurrence of the resurrection follows.
